title: Circular motion
target: Relate inward net force to a change in velocity direction.
criteria: Draw tangent velocity and inward acceleration.
Use v²/r or a supplied acceleration.
Identify the real interaction providing centripetal force.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A car follows a circle at constant speed. How are velocity and acceleration directed?
cpa.guide: Direction change requires inward acceleration even at constant speed.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: At the rightmost point of a clockwise circle, which pair is correct?
cpa.guide: Clockwise tangent points down; center lies left.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: An object moves at 6 m/s on a circle of radius 3 m. What is centripetal acceleration?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 1.5 kg object has inward acceleration 8 m/s². What is inward net force?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A ball moves in a horizontal circle on a string. Which interaction can supply the inward force?
options: An extra force named centripetal that exists separately from interactions.
Velocity itself acting as a force.
cpa.guide: Centripetal describes the inward role of real forces such as tension.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A car turns on a flat road with no banking. What commonly provides its inward horizontal force?
options: The car’s speed with no interaction.
A separate inward force added on top of all interactions.
cpa.guide: Tire-road friction can act toward the turn center.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
